closest_known_prior_comparison.name: AutoResearchClaw: Self-Reinforcing Autonomous Research with Human-AI Collaboration (arXiv 2605.20025)
closest_known_prior_comparison.not_reused_from_k2_regimes: Confirmed NOT the K2/Regimes citation (arXiv 2606.10241) already in docs/spec/publication-v1.md -- that citation is written against K2's G1/G2/G3 capability-delta gain gate, a materially different mechanism (per anti-gaming-contract-v1.md (c) C1's own kill-criterion note, reusing it here without independent verification would itself be a plausible_not_falsifiable_claim). This is a fresh, independently-run literature check for THIS specific mechanism.
closest_known_prior_comparison.why_closest: Same application domain as Ember's own use case: an autonomous, self-reinforcing AI research loop that must prevent fabricated numeric results and hallucinated citations from its own agents, evaluated with an explicit human-in-the-loop ablation across seven intervention modes (per the paper's own abstract, verified via WebFetch this session). This is the closest SAME-DOMAIN prior found (autonomous-research self-fabrication prevention), as opposed to a general reward-hacking-detection paper from a different application area.
closest_known_prior_comparison.material_difference: AutoResearchClaw's verification mechanism is GROUND-TRUTH-DEPENDENT: it constructs and maintains an independently-populated 'verified numeric registry' and post-hoc checks every generated numeric claim against that separate registry (plus human-in-the-loop intervention). C1's mechanism is SELF-CONTAINED per-record: it re-derives a verdict from a single receipt's OWN already-written internal fields (placeholder markers, hash well-formedness, nested pass/fail consistency, deletion-vs-treatment score comparison, explicit value/threshold/claim consistency, delta/ratio sign, paid-surface disclosure) with NO external registry, no independent execution log, and no human intervention required at check time. This trades recall for zero infrastructure dependency and near-zero marginal cost: it is honestly documented (anti-gaming-contract-v1.md sec11 A1, and this run's own fx04/fx06 findings) that internally-CONSISTENT fabrication -- or a fabrication using a field-naming/nesting shape the current S1-S7 patterns do not yet cover -- evades it in both the intact and deleted arm identically, exactly the class of gap a registry-based or re-execution-based check (like AutoResearchClaw's) would still catch. C1 is a narrower, cheaper, complementary layer, not a replacement for ground-truth verification.
closest_known_prior_comparison.secondary_taxonomic_reference: From Agent Traces to Trust: A Survey of Evidence Tracing and Execution Provenance in LLM Agents (arXiv 2606.04990, WebFetch-verified this session) frames the broader design space C1 sits inside -- 'logging vs semantic provenance' and 'static schema vs runtime enforcement' are named axes in that survey's own taxonomy -- but the survey itself is a taxonomy/framework paper, not a proposed-and-ablated mechanism, so AutoResearchClaw (same domain, concrete ablated mechanism) is cited as the primary closest prior per the one-prior requirement.

material_difference_over_prior.claim: For receipt shapes within the CURRENT S1-S7 pattern coverage (unfilled operator-fill markers in load-bearing fields; malformed or unfilled cryptographic-digest values; a top-level PASS riding a nested failing gate/verdict; a deletion/ablation arm reported numerically equal to its own sibling treatment-arm leaf key in the same dict; an explicit or trio value/threshold/claims_pass assertion that contradicts its own arithmetic; a delta or suffix-anchored _ratio field with the wrong sign; undisclosed paid-API-surface use) -- contribution-level deletion of the S1-S7 detector collapses detection of externally-authored, ledgered-incident-shaped fabricated receipts from providing real coverage to providing none, while leaving genuinely clean receipts unaffected in either arm.
falsifiable_predictions: With the detector present (intact arm), the 8-fixture external-disjoint suite is caught at >0/8 and the 2 clean controls are caught at 0/2 (measured: 5/8 caught, 0/2 false positives).

With the detector contribution-level deleted (S1-S7 short-circuited to an unconditional empty finding list, all other plumbing -- schema shape, CLI, dedup -- left byte-identical), the SAME 8-fixture suite's detection rate strictly decreases and the 2 clean controls remain at 0/2 false positives (measured: 0/8 caught, 0/2 false positives -- a full collapse, not merely a decrease).

The pre-existing 11-case --selftest, run unmodified under both arms, shows the identical collapse pattern independently of this run's own fixture authorship (measured: 11/11 to 2/11, the 2 survivors being the two cases that already expect a CLEAN result).
material_difference_over_prior.ml_ai_contribution_scope: An evaluation/verification methodology for autonomous self-improvement loops: how to test, with a held-out adversarial fixture set grounded in real incidents (not the detector's own calibration set), whether a receipt-level self-attestation detector is load-bearing versus decorative. Not a new model architecture, not a benchmark SOTA result, not a training-loop change.

known_limitations_disclosed_not_hidden: fx04 (S4 shape): the REAL C11 receipt's actual ablation schema nests the with/without arms as two separate sub-dicts (deletion_ablation.with_carry_forward{...} / deletion_ablation.without_carry_forward_ablated{...}); the current _check_deletion_load_bearing only compares sibling LEAF keys within the SAME dict (the selftest's flat arms:{a_score,b_score,c_score,deleted_score} shape). A fabricated receipt using the real nested shape with faked-equal numbers is MISSED by the intact checker too -- a genuine, newly-discovered structural coverage gap, not a fixture-authoring error (verified against the real receipt's own schema).

fx06 (S6 shape): _RATIO_KEY_RE requires the key to literally END in '_ratio' (or be 'speedup'/'compound'); the real field name flop_saving_ratio_fromscratch_over_growpath (taken verbatim from the actual C2 receipt cited in docs/spec/c8-claim-ladder.md) has '_ratio_' in the middle, not at the end, so S6 never fires on this exact real field name, in either arm. A second genuine coverage gap.

fx08 (phantom-receipt shape): missing-file phantom detection is check_goal_citations.py's job (path-existence), a DIFFERENT already-built mechanism, not S1-S7's. Both arms correctly miss it; this is a scope boundary, not a defect, and is not counted against the detection-rate claim above beyond being excluded from the 'within current pattern coverage' scope statement.
